newsitem.title: USA: Intel, techs take Nasdaq lower at close.
newsitem.headline: Intel, techs take Nasdaq lower at close.

text.p: As went Intel Corp, so went Nasdaq. The sell-off in shares of the high tech giant on Tuesday pounded Nasdaq stocks one day after they hit a new closing high.
The Composite was down 6.11 points, or 0.48 percent, at 1256.56 at its unofficial close while declines led advances by 2191 to 2033 on volume of about 600 million shares.
Intel shares reversed course and fell 2-7/8 to 121 as traders interpreted a Goldman Sachs call to clients as a caution that computer sales may be slowing.
Analysts attributed the sell-off in Nasdaq to the weakness in Intel, Microsoft Corp and Cisco Systems Inc, among the most heavily weighted stocks in the index.
Microsoft fell 1-7/8 to 141-3/4 while Cisco fell 1-1/2 at 65. Intel shares reversed direction at 1400 EST/1900 GMT.
Data networking stocks were hit by profit-taking after strong price gains in recent weeks. Ascend Communications Inc was down 3-1/4 at 70-1/8 and 3Com Corp fell 1-1/4 to 70-7/8.
Informix Corp, the most actively traded Nasdaq issue, was down three at 17-5/8 after two brokerages cut their earnings per share estimates for the company.
